title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 75: Our World (Review)

lessons.title: tourism + natural wonder(93w)
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and do the following tasks.

Vietnam is a great destination for those who love hunting for natural wonders and breathtaking landscapes. The country possesses many beautiful sites, from towering mountains to stunning beaches. One of the most well-known natural wonders is Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its limestone islands.

Another must-visit location is Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, which has some of the largest caves in the world. Unexpected discoveries often occur when exploring these unique places. Tourists can take advantage of guided tours to learn more about the area's history and biodiversity.

lessons.title: natural disaster(64w)
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and do the following tasks.

A powerful storm hit the coastal town and caused numerous houses to collapse. The local authority quickly organized rescue teams to help affected families. Special volunteers participated in cleanup efforts, as the flood had left toxic waste in the streets. Luckily, the evacuation plan had been followed, so there were no serious injuries. The damage was mainly to property, but recovery would take time.
